latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ai-ahegao-ai-openapi-skill.

- Transform a portrait photo into an exaggerated anime-style ahegao expression using AI.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WeShop API key.
- Upload, transform, and fetch resulting anime-style images via documented API endpoints.
- Provides API key security guidelines to protect your credentials.
- Supports batch generation and custom expression descriptions.
